# Switch NX2 - read at every start of the Satsuma GUI. The CLI frontend does not read it.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, %APPDATA%\satsuma\nx2_switches.txt (yours) wins over this one, so editing
# this file is never needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- workarounds / behaviour ---
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=1
#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0
#EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1

# --- limits / tuning ---
#EDEN_NX2_VRAM_LIMIT_MIB=8192
#EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE=0
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2
#EDEN_NX2_TC_EXPECTED_MIB=21322
#EDEN_NX2_TC_CRITICAL_MIB=22346

# Satsuma performance defaults, matching the established launcher.
EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ=120
EDEN_NX2_TC_EXPECTED_MIB=3072
EDEN_NX2_TC_CRITICAL_MIB=4096
EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
EDEN_NX2_BANK_REFRESH=0
EDEN_NX2_SPARSE_REMAP=1
EDEN_NX2_DMA_SCATTER=0

# GPU-only regions (nx2:gpu 214) get memory as the GPU writes them; =0 backs them whole.
#EDEN_NX2_GPU_ONLY_LAZY=0

# Sparse texture tiles (nx2:gpu 216): the game maps its own memory into its sparse regions, and GPU
# writes outside its tiles are dropped. =0 (in your own file, which wins over the line above) turns
# it off: no 216, sparse regions get graphics memory per block as the GPU writes them, as before.
#EDEN_NX2_SPARSE_REMAP=0
# Large single images over sparse tiles get host memory per sparse block. Where the driver can't
# sample unbound memory (AMD) empty blocks share one zeroed block; =1 shares it on any driver
# that supports it, =0 never. EDEN_NX2_SPARSE_UNBACKED=1/0 overrides that driver check.
#EDEN_NX2_SPARSE_ALIASED=1
#EDEN_NX2_SPARSE_UNBACKED=0

# With the GPU split, command lists submitted after a GPU memory map wait for the map before they
# are read (Mario Kart World's command-stream desync); =0 doesn't wait, as before.
#EDEN_NX2_MAP_BEFORE_READS=0

# =0: no Vulkan descriptor buffers (descriptor sets instead), so RenderDoc can replay frame
# captures on NVIDIA. For capture runs only.
#EDEN_NX2_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER=0

# Macro parameters in an entry of their own are flushed from the caches only on pages GPU work has
# written; =2 waits for the split's back and checks every such entry, as before.
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=2

# Per game: EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ_<program ID> overrides EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ for that game.
# Super Mario Bros. Wonder capped at 67.
EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ_010015100B514000=67

# Switch 2 Editions of Switch 1 games: installed DLC laid over the game files; =0 turns it off.
#EDEN_NX2_EDITION_DLC=0

# Lichii build 75 behaviours, off by default (Mario Kart World and Switch Sports regressed with them):
# GPU report timestamps in nanoseconds; native compute storage buffers from their pointer alone.
#EDEN_NX2_GPU_TIME_NS=1
#EDEN_NX2_SSBO_POINTER_ONLY=1
